pack.source_title: IRAS: Tax Residency of a Company / Certificate of Residence

tests.label: At least 50% of strategic directors physically in Singapore or Chairman physically in Singapore for virtual meetings
tests.quote: At least 50% of the directors (with the authority to make strategic decisions) are physically in Singapore during the meetings; or Chairman of the Board of Directors (if the company has such an appointment) is physically in Singapore during the meeting.

not_supported.requirement: location of Board meetings where strategic decisions are made determines control and management
not_supported.quote: Usually, the location of the company's Board of Directors meetings where strategic decisions are made determines where the control and management is exercised.

not_supported.requirement: holding Board meetings in Singapore may not be sufficient in certain scenarios
not_supported.quote: Under certain scenarios, holding Board of Directors meetings in Singapore may not be sufficient and IRAS will consider all facts provided by the company to determine if the control and management of the business is indeed exercised in Singapore.

not_supported.requirement: whether any board meetings held in Singapore
not_supported.quote: Whether there is any board of directors' meetings held in Singapore

not_supported.requirement: whether strategic decisions are made at board meetings held in Singapore
not_supported.quote: Whether any strategic decisions are made at the board of directors' meetings held in Singapore

not_supported.requirement: whether directors are based in or outside Singapore
not_supported.quote: Whether the directors are based in or outside Singapore

not_supported.requirement: whether strategic decisions are made by local director in Singapore
not_supported.quote: Whether any strategic decisions are made by the local director in Singapore

not_supported.requirement: whether key employees based in Singapore
not_supported.quote: Whether there are key employees based in Singapore
